title: Performance Reporting Service Levels — Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Performance Reporting Service Levels

Service levels for the performance report and the reporting deliverables of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions, by tier.

| Tier | Report frequency | Report delivered within (business days after the period closes) | Credit of the period's subscription fee for a late report (percent) | Benchmarking against comparable buildings | Annual energy performance submission prepared | Emissions reporting alongside energy reporting |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Utility Bill Tracking Subscription | quarterly | 15 | 10 | no | no | no |
| Metering & Dashboard Subscription | monthly | 12 | 10 | yes | no | no |
| Energy Analytics Subscription | monthly | 10 | 15 | yes | yes | no |
| Fault Detection & Diagnostics Subscription | monthly | 8 | 15 | yes | yes | yes |
| Measurement & Verification Program | monthly | 7 | 20 | yes | yes | yes |
| Managed Energy Performance Program | monthly | 5 | 25 | yes | yes | yes |


## What each line fixes

1. **Frequency** — how often the performance report is issued. The Utility Bill Tracking Subscription reports quarterly; every other tier reports monthly.
2. **Delivery period** — the number of business days after the reported period closes by which the report is delivered.
3. **Late report credit** — the percentage of that period's subscription fee credited when the report is delivered after the delivery period.
4. **Benchmarking, performance submission and emissions reporting** — whether the tier includes each deliverable.

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical)

- A Measurement & Verification Program report for a period that closed on a Monday is within its service level when delivered on or before the seventh business day after that Monday; delivered on the eighth business day it is late, and the credit is 20 percent of that period's subscription fee.
- An Energy Analytics Subscription includes benchmarking and the annual performance submission but not emissions reporting; a Fault Detection & Diagnostics Subscription includes all three.
